### Describe the bug

When attempting to use the `transforms.MessageTokenLimiter(max_tokens=1000)` on a chatbot, 
I receive error `IndexError: list index out of range`

Because
` /home/ish/.venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/autogen/agentchat/conversable_agent.py` line `1659` fails because `messages` is an empty list and not `None` as expected

### Steps to reproduce

create a chatbot agent with registered functions and attempt to add the MessageTokenLimiter `context_handling.add_to_agent(chatbot)`

linked_prs.body:

## Why are these changes needed?

The current implementation of the token limiter, specifically the total token limiter (`max_tokens` arg), drops the entire message if it exceeds the total token count after truncating the content. This seems to be an undesired behavior by users as it is unintuitive. With this approach, the last message gets truncated to meet the total token count.

## Related issue number

Closes #2341

ai_judgment.response: Yes, this is an agent issue. The problem involves a memory-related issue where the `messages` list is unexpectedly empty, causing an error in the `MessageTokenLimiter`. This aligns with the "Memory content errors" sub-category under the taxonomy of agent issues.
